name: Audience-switch hero
definition: Hero with tabs for each audience; choosing one swaps the headline, value line and visual to that use case.
bestUse: Products sold to several roles that each need a different first sentence.

demo.how: One page, several first impressions: each tab rewrites the headline and the value line for one role while the call to action stays the same. Click a tab, or focus the tabs and use the arrow keys, to switch audience. The copy is illustrative.
